propositions: The portable claim template incorrectly instructs all projects to pass --assignee instead of omitting it when a default assignee is configured.
Template guidance must document behavior for both configured ticket.default_assignee and empty/absent default assignee states.
Explicit assignee identity requirements (email or accountId) should only apply to Jira-reconciled stores and explicit overrides, not universally.
The link relation inventory is missing caused_by which should be added to the comprehensive list.
The generated region in templates/AGENTS.md must stay byte-synchronized with the canonical templates/rebar-usage.md through the established template ownership mechanism.
Repository-specific Gerrit workflow guidance should not appear in the portable template and should be excluded.
